name: Semrush
notes: Annual billing is $117.33 a month. Tracks 500 keywords daily. AI writer is not named on the page; content optimization is on Pro+ ($299 monthly).

name: Google Search Console
since_note: Launched as Google Webmaster Tools in 2006 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Seeing which searches show your site
notes: Free Google service. Shows the queries your site appears for and clicks. Help page does not explicitly mention a position metric. Only covers your own site.

name: GravityWrite
usage_note: 500 AI credits a month on Plus (about 15 blogs)
since_note: Established 2023 in Chennai, India (Zoftwarehub); SourceForge lists 2017, likely the parent company.
best_for: Cheap AI blog and content drafts
notes: Plus is $97 billed yearly. Pro is $599 a year for 2,500 credits. A free plan is hinted in the page description but not shown. Keywords and WordPress publishing not stated.

name: Jasper
free_plan_limits: No free plan; 7-day free trial of Pro
since_note: Founded January 2021 in Austin; first launched as Conversion.ai/Jarvis in early 2021 (aiwiki.ai).
notes: Pro is 1 seat; more users need Business (custom, 12-month minimum). Yearly is $59 a month. Mentions Webflow and Google Docs integrations; SEO and publishing by plan not stated.

name: Ahrefs
free_plan_limits: Ahrefs data for your own verified site only
since_note: Company started July 2010 by Dmitry Gerasimenko (Inblog profile); first paid product 2011.
notes: Starter ($29) is keyword research only. Lite tracks 750 keywords. AI content helper is a Content Kit add-on from $99 and listed as soon. Annual saves up to 17%.

name: Arvow
free_plan_limits: No free plan or trial stated
usage_note: 1,000 credits a month; an article costs 15 credits
since_note: Founded 1 April 2023 in Singapore, formerly Journalist AI (AppSumo listing).
best_for: Auto-written blog posts on a schedule
notes: Billing cycle not stated on the page ($39 shown against a crossed-out $69). Solo covers 1 site, about 66 plain articles. Integrations include WordPress, Shopify and Ghost.

name: Grammarly
free_plan_limits: Spelling and grammar, 100 AI prompts a month
notes: Pro adds rewrites, plagiarism and AI-text checks, 2,000 prompts a month. Page does not list annual pricing. Not an SEO tool; feature values for SEO columns are from the product's scope.

name: Copy.ai
since_note: Founded 2020 (Contrary Research company profile); launch month varies by source.
best_for: Chat-based marketing copy for small teams
notes: Chat plan includes 5 seats; $24 a month billed yearly. Next plan is $1,000 a month (Growth, workflows). Page has a Try for free button but no free limits.

name: Surfer
free_plan_limits: No free plan; page says Start for Free, terms not stated
since_note: Founded 2017 in Wroclaw, Poland (Dashly tool profile).
notes: Page shows only prices billed yearly; annual saves up to 17%. WordPress and Google Docs integrations start on Standard. Keyword research and rank tracking not clearly stated.
